newsitem.title: USA: Nice up in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Nice up in active trade.

text.p: Nice Systems Ltd's American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) rose Tuesday in active trade, helped by presentations to analysts and investors, traders said.
Nice, an Israeli maker of digital recording and retrieval systems, was up 2-1/8 to 32-1/8. Volume in mid-afternoon was 219,100 ADRs, almost three times normal daily activity.
Traders and analysts said the company's presentations to analysts and investors in part propelled the rise. They began in Europe and will come to the United States next week.
"It's more the road show than anything else. It started yesterday in Europe," a market analyst said.
The presentations are ahead of the company's planned public offering of 2.5 million ADRs. They could be offered in coming months.
